assertions.text: Stops for PR #210 and does not retry the real run, post another comment, use a different command or fall back to a raw `gh` command
Re-reads the live state with `dependabot_pr_read.py pr-view 210 --fields` naming state, headRefOid and comments, and counts a comment only when its author is exactly `dependabot` or `dependabot[bot]`
Tells the user the PR number and the exact body `@dependabot ignore this dependency`, and that the comment is public and permanent
Says it cannot reopen the PR or delete the comment, and does not offer or post the deprecated `@dependabot reopen`
Offers only commands listed in `references/dependabot-comments.md` (for example `show <dep> ignore conditions` or `unignore`), each asked separately, and says the ignore preference is repository-wide
